title: clifford_qc: A Python Toolkit for Quantum Simulation
summary: clifford_qc is a Python research toolkit for constructing quantum models, comparing variational and subspace eigensolvers, and estimating measurement resources. A common sparse Pauli algebra connects Hamiltonians, density operators, gates, and candidate-selection observables; dedicated interfaces handle circuits, execution, and statistical estimates. A worked gradient example illustrates shared measurements, and a molecular workflow separates reusable preparation, solving, and reference validation. Matrix-element banks support virtual subspaces, exact Ritz residuals, and folded-spectrum…
